items.title: Data-race safety diagnostics
items.text: Actors isolate mutable state, while Sendable describes values safe to transfer across concurrency domains. Let compiler diagnostics guide isolation boundaries rather than bypassing them.

items.title: Migrating existing code
items.text: Treat migrating existing code as a specialist or version-sensitive area. Verify target support and toolchain assumptions first, isolate platform-specific code, and document limitations instead of treating experimental support as universal.

items.title: Addressing concurrency warnings and errors
items.text: Use typed errors for operations that can fail and handle them at a boundary that can recover or explain the failure. Do not silently discard meaningful errors.
